manifest_binding.rule: Every Atomic Bundle manifest MUST bind to the active version set exactly. Partial version drift fails closed. build_id identifies an immutable artifact and is not a contract version.

major: breaking schema or manifest shape change
removal or semantic redefinition of an existing enum
breaking change to actionability, fallback, null, or UNKNOWN semantics
minor: new enum value or registry capability requiring coordinated consumer support
new compatible dataset or contract surface
patch: documentation or metadata correction with no accepted-domain change
validator or implementation fix that preserves contract semantics
bump_policy.engine_only: Any Decision Engine behavior change MUST bump engine_version and mint a new version_set_id even when schemas and registries are unchanged.
